connections.why: Generate pictures for ads and posts
Read competitors' ads and posts for research

suggestions.label: Set up my brand from my website
suggestions.prompt: Set up my brand with the brand skill: crawl my website into raw/site with tt-crawl (the brand playbook), then write brand/ and public/ from it, every line cited. Copy my best real photos into brand/images and list them in brand/images.md. Tell me what you could not find and ask me for it in one message. My website is:

suggestions.label: Tell you about the business
suggestions.prompt: I'd rather tell you about the business than have you read a website. Ask me, in one message, the few things you need for brand/ and public/ (what we do, for whom, what makes us different, how we sound, where we work), save my answers to raw/transcripts first, then write the notes with the brand skill.

suggestions.label: Research my competitors
suggestions.prompt: Research my market with the research skill: ask me for three to five competitors (or suggest them from my search terms), read what customers say in reviews and comments, what the competitors run in the ad libraries and post organically, and write research/brief.md with ranked hypotheses. Tell me the three things that change what we should make.

suggestions.label: Give me ideas for ads
suggestions.prompt: Use the ideas skill on research/brief.md and the brand notes: write ten to fifteen candidate ideas, score them, keep the nine that differ in argument, and give me one line each so I can choose which to make first.

suggestions.label: Make a test set of ads
suggestions.prompt: Make a test set of ads with the ad skill from the ideas I chose: three angles in three formats or hooks, each with its hook, copy and picture, audited with scripts/check.py and the tropes skill. Show them to me as deliverables with one line each.

suggestions.label: Write this week's posts
suggestions.prompt: Write this week's organic posts with the social-post skill from one idea I give you: one post per platform I use, each rewritten for its platform, with my own photos where there are any. Show me each caption as it will appear. The idea is:

suggestions.label: What is waiting for my approval
suggestions.prompt: List the creatives with status sent (python3 scripts/check.py first), newest first, one line each with the idea and the platform, and attach their files as deliverables so I can approve or reject each.

suggestions.label: Record the results
suggestions.prompt: Record what my ads did in results.md, newest first: the creative's folder, the platform, the dates, hook rate, hold rate, click-through and cost per lead from my ad account (ask me to paste them if there is no connection). Then tell me what to make next: new hooks for a winner, a new angle for a loser.

suggestions.label: Re-verify the platform specs
suggestions.prompt: One or more sheets in specs/ are more than 90 days old (python3 scripts/check.py says which). Re-verify each against the platform's own help pages, as specs/README.md describes, update the numbers and last_verified, and tell me what changed.
